summary: R0 scientific-semantic repair completed and committed at aec4c655cd9d7c4975059cc707c760f7b7af3351 on detached HEAD. The #189 capture and raw evidence remain unchanged; no campaign or physics integration was run.
completed: Added a versioned #189 erratum and prominent RESULTS link. Retained the 5 cm, 10 cm, and repeated-step PASS conclusions; scoped the low_friction_cross PASS to its frozen geometric/task-goal checks; corrected the yaw metric while retaining PERFORMANCE_FAIL.
Restored the seven listed schema-2 maintenance files from historical capture commit e40b0933572345f23b37e3bb06350518fde63e76 without cherry-picking the historical branch.
Fixed analyzer and independent-verifier free-joint angular-velocity semantics and added permanent regression tests for both.
Added scene_low_friction_patch_v2.xml and a runtime mj_forward test of patch support, effective friction/condim, and absence of normal-floor support.
Added ADR-0001 and synchronized PROJECT_RECORD, TOPIC_AUDIT, current.json, and generated CURRENT with planned architecture, executable surface, and verified results explicitly separated.

Passed targeted semantic tests, schema-2 portable tests, current preflight/identity tests, standard quality/hygiene checks, generated CURRENT consistency checks, and the same suites/checks from a fresh detached checkout.
Committed all 15 intended tracked files directly to the prepared detached worktree; the committed worktree is clean.
not_completed: The Ruff lint/format stage of tools.check_quality --style could not complete because Ruff is absent from the available Python environment; the standard-library quality and repository hygiene checks passed.
No capability experiment was run on the v2 low-friction fixture, as required by the frozen task.

observations.text: In the compiled v1 scene at the representative pose, all four feet had both normal-floor and patch contacts. Each foot-patch mjContact had dim=6 and friction [0.8, 0.8, 0.02, 0.01, 0.01]; foot geom priority was 1 and patch priority was 0.

The corrected yaw recomputation selected ticks [100, 2500) from 2,501 raw rows. The raw trace SHA-256 was unchanged; command wz=0.5, mean body-local qvel-z=0.10389565426144981 rad/s, MAE=0.3961043457385502 rad/s, tolerance=0.1 rad/s, and physics_steps=0.

The original #189 analyses record PASS for step_5cm_cross, step_10cm_cross, repeated_steps_cross, and low_friction_cross; flat_yaw_probe is PERFORMANCE_FAIL. The frozen protocol has nine cases, max_attempts=9, and retry=none.

The v2 fixture produced four foot-to-patch contacts and no foot-to-normal-floor contact under mj_forward. Every observed patch contact had dim=6 and friction [0.0001, 0.0001, 0.0001, 0.0005, 0.0005]; simulation time remained 0.
The restored schema-2 suite passed 37 tests with 3 skipped; the current preflight/identity suite passed 36 tests. The same results were reproduced in a fresh detached checkout at the final commit.

The initial raw-trace hash check compared byte-level JSONL hashes against semantic trajectory digests and reported mismatches. The corrected audit compares byte-level hashes to the sealed capture manifest, and all five checked raw traces match it.
The final commit is aec4c655cd9d7c4975059cc707c760f7b7af3351, parent 9d9340b1f449d2b2018474fba9633221af760691; the task worktree is detached and clean. The v1 scene hash matches its parent commit.
All six exported logical Praxis identity values (repository, issue, branch, starting commit, task path, and evidence directory) match the frozen task identity; Git remained detached.
Final evidence validation found the closeout and progress schemas valid, every cited evidence path present, and the committed task worktree detached and clean.

inferences.text: Because v1 selects foot friction for foot-patch contacts and simultaneously permits normal-floor support, the frozen low_friction_cross PASS does not provide evidence of low-friction robustness.
Because corrected yaw MAE 0.3961043457 rad/s exceeds the frozen 0.1 rad/s tolerance, the yaw case remains PERFORMANCE_FAIL despite the corrected mean differing slightly from the original report.
The v2 test establishes intended compiled/runtime contact semantics only; it does not establish robot performance or low-friction robustness on that scene.

conclusions.text: Retain the 5 cm, 10 cm, and repeated 5/15/5 cm PASS conclusions. Retain the original low_friction_cross output classification only as a frozen-scene geometric/task-goal PASS, and withdraw its low-friction-robustness interpretation.
Retain flat_yaw_probe as PERFORMANCE_FAIL under the frozen tolerance using corrected body-local qvel-z metrics.

The canonical architecture now describes MuJoCo as current evaluation physics, MuJoCo/MJX as planned but incomplete, Go2 as the first testbed, and MJPC/iLQR as a strong comparator. Existing capabilities remain task-specific; no generic multi-controller platform or cross-controller scientific bottleneck is claimed.
R0 is complete: required tracked changes are committed, acceptance evidence is preserved, and no new scientific attempt was consumed.

uncertainty.text: No capability experiment was run on the v2 fixture, so its effect on locomotion performance and robustness remains unmeasured.
Ruff-specific lint and formatting remain unverified because Ruff was unavailable; standard syntax, quality, whitespace, and repository hygiene checks passed.
The first raw-hash comparison was invalid because it mixed byte-level and semantic hash domains; the corrected manifest comparison passes and the failed attempt is retained for audit.
